lines: Your business is earning. Your next move needs capital.
Meet Bondrail. Issue revenue bonds, raise capital, and repay investors from revenue.
picture: Actual landing hero; slow 1.0–1.12 push toward headline. Follow the Invest click into the app. No opening title card.

lines: This is PumpLab, one of our testnet businesses. Every trade builds a revenue history.
Investors can see the payments behind the numbers, including which payers are linked to the issuer.
Bondrail uses that history to estimate a credit line.
picture: Enter actual PumpLab account. Move focus from revenue to excluded payers to estimate. Keep controlled-test-wallet disclosure visible.

lines: PumpLab raised twenty USDC. Ten went to the business; ten stays in escrow.
The next release needs a revenue milestone and a time window. So investors don't put all their capital at risk on day one.
picture: Bond release ribbon then actual terms. Brief factual callout: 20 raised / 10 released / 10 held. Full cap and current effective cap remain distinct.

lines: Now watch what happens when a customer trades.
This is a real test-wallet payment on Monad. A quarter of the trading fee goes straight to the bond, in that same transaction.
The repayment balance rises. Here's the transfer that proves it.
No separate collection step.
picture: Reuse exact original recorded Native before/update; smoothly zoom repayment then backing. Cut to actual decoded receipt, focus 0.0025-USDC bond transfer. Label Node-automated test-wallet action and receipt provenance.

lines: And investors can trade their claims on Kuru.
Enter an amount. Check the live quote. Buy.
The transaction confirms, and the claims land in the wallet.
The market prices future revenue. Cash backing shows what's already been collected.
picture: Reuse actual Kuru input/quote/click/confirmation at original speed. Camera follows quote -> button -> claims. Avoid padding with frozen full-screen holds.

lines: Want to fund a business earlier? CurveLab is still raising.
Here, one test USDC becomes one claim. While funding stays open, the investor can withdraw.
If the raise expires, cancellation makes refunds available.
picture: Original real deposit action. Start tight on amount and click; pull back to show claim and raised balance. Do not imply withdrawal was executed.

lines: Bondrail also supports paid APIs.
For these Watched businesses, Chainlink CRE simulation checks payment destinations and broadcasts reports to Monad.
Here's a compliant report onchain. Checks run every thirty minutes; confirmed violations trigger default and stake slashing.
HTTP payment receipts are split when swept.
picture: Actual monitoring timestamp and report; then real receipt. Small technical note: two adjacent violation epochs. No default simulation shown as a real event.

lines: Revenue becomes history. History unlocks capital. Future revenue repays it.
That's Bondrail. Revenue bonds for onchain businesses.
picture: Return to actual landing hero with app URL. Brief smooth pullback, no static card. End clearly on product.
